features.covered_by: story_get CHK-001 files.create contains only docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-llm-usage-ledger-execution-plan.md; plan_get CHK-001 Deliverable names the same path.

features.feature: Document-only execution-plan content for LLM usage ledger
features.covered_by: plan_get Scope says the story produces one execution-plan document for a future implementation; CHK-001 specifies problem statement, record model/taxonomy, local CLI behavior, Authority boundary, future touchpoints, validation/smoke coverage, non-goals, and fail-closed behavior as document content.

features.feature: True usage vs estimate and local Non-authority vs Authority receipt boundaries are in scope for the document
features.covered_by: story_get checklist context and verificationIntent require distinguishing provider-reported true usage, approximate prompt-size estimates, unavailable provider usage, local Non-authority records, and Authority Server receipt-backed proof.

features.feature: Document validation is limited to docs checks
features.covered_by: plan_get Validation requires rg checks for required positive terms and negative Authority-overclaim controls, then docs_check verification evidence for happy, edge, and adversarial intents.

features.excluded_by: plan_get Scope explicitly excludes CLI code, provider parsers, budget enforcement changes, runtime registry changes, and provider implementation work; story_get files.modify is empty and files.test is empty.
